def power_mod(base, exp, mod=1000000007):
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
        base = (base * base) % mod
    return result

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    if k == 0:
        print(power_mod(p, p - 1))
        return
    if k == 1:
        print(power_mod(p, p))
        return
    mark = [False] * p
    cycle_count = 0
    for i in range(1, p):
        if mark[i]:
            continue
        current = i
        while not mark[current]:
            mark[current] = True
            current = (current * k) % p
        cycle_count += 1
    print(power_mod(p, cycle_count))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
